stages.name: Lateral movement via RMM and NetExec

scenario.summary: A threat actor used a trojanized MSI installer to deploy EtherRAT, leveraging Ethereum blockchain and TryCloudflare for resilient C2 before deploying the TukTuk framework via DLL sideloading. The intrusion progressed through extensive AD discovery and lateral movement using NetExec and GoTo Resolve, concluding with data exfiltration via Rclone and domain-wide deployment of The Gentleman ransomware via GPO and scheduled tasks.

meta.rationale: Focus on domain controllers and file servers first. Expand scope if SoftPerfect or GoTo Resolve execution is found on any workstation.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has moved laterally from an RMM-controlled beachhead using NetExec or GoTo Resolve to dump credentials and exfiltrate data to Wasabi before initiating domain-wide encryption via GPO.

hunt.name: Lateral Movement and Ransomware Deployment: The Gentlemen
hunt.description: This hunt targets the hands-on-keyboard phase of a ransomware intrusion. It begins by scoping for hosts showing portable RMM execution, such as GoTo Resolve or SoftPerfect, which are used as beachheads. The first phase hunts for credential dumping and lateral tools by looking for behavioral strings and original file names that survive renaming. The second phase corroborates this with network traffic to cloud storage and final-stage impact commands. An agent correlates these stages to distinguish administrative activity from a ransomware kill chain.

nodes.label: Identify portable RMM and scanner execution

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%goto%resolve%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%netscan%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%netscan%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Locate hosts running GoTo Resolve or SoftPerfect Network Scanner. These define the primary hosts of interest for the lateral movement phase.
config.expected_signal: Execution of GoTo Resolve or NetScan binaries. Silence means these specific tools were not launched, not that no RMM activity occurred.

primitive_config.label: Identify portable RMM and scanner execution

primitive_config.expected: Execution of GoTo Resolve or NetScan binaries. Silence means these specific tools were not launched, not that no RMM activity occurred.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%comsvcs.dll%#+0000%24%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify process execution targeting LSASS memory using the comsvcs.dll ordinal technique.
config.expected_signal: Command lines containing rundll32 and comsvcs.dll ordinal #24. This is a high-fidelity indicator of credential dumping.

nodes.label: Rare lateral tools by original name and behavior

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_original_file_name) AS original_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{lateral_tool_filenames}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_original_file_name) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%sekurlane%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%lsadump%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%netexec%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY 1 HAVING hosts <= 3
config.description: Identify lateral movement tools that may have been renamed to bypass process name detections.
config.expected_signal: Processes whose original file name or command line strings match known lateral tools. Rare occurrences (1-3 hosts) indicate adversary use.

config.objective: Identify hosts showing a high-confidence chain of beachhead RMM use followed by credential access and lateral tool execution.
config.description: Evaluate if observed beachhead RMM activity, LSASS dumping, and lateral tools constitute a suspicious movement phase.
config.expected_signal: A per-host verdict on the early-stage evidence.
config.success_criteria: A per-host verdict of malicious | suspicious citing specific process and original filename rows.

nodes.label: DNS lookups to Wasabi cloud storage

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, query_hostname, COUNT(*) AS lookups FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{wasabi_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
config.description: Identify outbound traffic to Wasabi, which the adversary used with Rclone for data exfiltration.
config.expected_signal: DNS queries for Wasabi domains from hosts identified in the early movement phase. Suspicious if originating from servers not performing authorized backups.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%vssadmin%delete%shadows%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%disable-mppreference%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%shadowcopy%delete%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

config.expected_signal: Commands used to delete backups and disable security controls. Any hit on a production server or DC is critical.

config.objective: Determine if the evidence chain from early movement to final destruction confirms an active Gentlemen ransomware intrusion.

config.description: Trigger immediate containment if an active ransomware chain is identified.
Prevent domain-wide encryption by isolating affected hosts identified in the kill chain.
config.instructions: Isolate the host immediately via the EDR. Proceed to manual review of GPO and RMM logs.

config.description: Examine evidence of GPO modifications and RMM task history which are not always visible in endpoint process logs.
config.instructions: Check Active Directory for recent GPO modifications in SYSVOL/NETLOGON. Review GoTo Resolve console logs for unauthorized tasks launched from beachhead IPs.
Record the hosts examined and whether the intrusion chain was present. If destructive behavior was found, pivot to Incident Response.
